models_evaluated: uRMC (unified data-driven respiratory motion correction, deep learning)
unlisted_practices: Comparing AI-based respiratory motion correction reconstruction with no motion correction on PET/CT image quality and lesion detection

screen.reason: The study conducts a clinical reader evaluation of a deep learning-based respiratory motion correction algorithm (uRMC) on PET/CT images from 100 patients to assess diagnostic quality, but does not test a health system deployment practice or safeguard.
